name: spreadsheets
description: Create, edit, analyze, visualize, render, and export spreadsheet files in Anybox.

shortDescription.zh-CN: 创建和编辑电子表格文件

longDescription.en-US: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally. Use Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is a spreadsheet, workbook, sheet, or CSV file.
longDescription.zh-CN: 在本地创建、编辑、检查、渲染、验证并导出 XLSX、CSV 和 TSV 电子表格。当目标产物是电子表格、工作簿、表格或 CSV 文件时使用 Spreadsheets。

skillPreviews.name: Spreadsheets
skillPreviews.description: Use this skill when a user requests to create, modify, analyze, visualize, or work with spreadsheet files (`.xlsx`, `.xls`, `.csv`, `.tsv`) with formulas, formatting, charts, tables, and recalculation.
